$comment: Commits that reached main without passing develop, which a human reviewed and accepted
in writing. scripts/check-branch-bypass.mjs fails on any unjudged commit NOT listed here,
so a NEW bypass still turns the gate red. An entry here is not a pardon: the perf gate
still measures the weight these commits added, and the guard prints every accepted entry
on every run so it cannot rot into being forgotten.
Adding an entry is a content decision with a real cost, so it must carry a reason and the
author who accepted it. Do not add a sha to make a red gate go away without saying what
the commit shipped and why shipping it is acceptable.

accepted.author: jaeko44 <pavilion.vps@gmail.com>
accepted.subject: Media Update
accepted.reason: Per-service marketplace imagery (7 media keys x 720w/1200w, +2,232,680 raw) plus 5 re-encodes. Every image is referenced from src/data/media.ts and rendered by marketplace/{gpu-compute,iaas,paas,storage}.astro, so it is live content, not leftovers. Reverting it would break four production pages. It is NOT accepted as free weight: the perf budget is still red on this weight and a separate decision on forward-porting or re-encoding is owed.

accepted.author: jaeko44 <pavilion.vps@gmail.com>
accepted.subject: Additional Project Symbiosis Information
accepted.reason: 52 files across three sites. det.io gains the visual-teaching surface: 11 new pages (/learn, /learn/[slug] x9, /research/human-machine-symbiosis), 5 interactive teaching labs (ResearchAtlas, EconomicLab, SafetyLab, SequenceLesson, CouplingLab) plus TeachingVisual and teaching.css, and src/data/learning.ts. Also docs content edits and virtengine.com copy changes. Forward-ported to develop by PR (this repo's develop tip + the forward-port), so a reviewed build has now judged it. The perf weight is NOT accepted as free: scripts/perf-baseline.json was re-measured in the same PR and det.io total-gzip moved 797854 -> 1030258 (+232,404 gzipped, +11 pages), recorded at truth rather than widened, so the ratchet holds from the new number. Recorded here because the guard keys on SHA ANCESTRY (git rev-list origin/main --not origin/develop), and a cherry-pick carries new shas, so no forward-port can ever make this guard green: the original shas on main must be dispositioned here. 92fc1c5 is untouched.
